note: How cooking works, from community guides; the recipes and dish values themselves come from the game's files, not from here.
facts: Cooking is done in the Nutrient Processor, which you can build in a base, find on your freighter and in the Space Anomaly; you need the recipe known and the ingredients in your inventory.

Edible products give temporary buffs (health regeneration, hazard protection, jetpack efficiency); raw ingredients give weaker ones. Dishes can be sold to visiting pilots at space stations or at Galactic Trade Terminals.
Iteration Cronus on the Space Anomaly judges a cooked dish and pays 0 to 130 Nanites depending on how much he likes it.
